lixpiValue: set per model and routing mode
summary: Selects the provider's image-content moderation strictness. It changes provider filtering behavior, not image style or visual quality, and a rejected request still produces a normalized provider error rather than pixels.
combines: Supported for GPT Image 2 generation and editing requests.
Lixpi resolves it through `mediaProviderDefinition.moderation.settings` so text-only and image-conditioned requests use the reviewed policy profile consistently.
It is independent of size, quality, background, and output format and is not a per-prompt user control.

usage.what: Content-filter strictness, resolved per model and per input mode rather than fixed, so a reference-driven edit and a text prompt can carry different policy.
